upload_diff_to_codereview: run upload.py to upload diffs from git svn or mercurial to the codereview.appspot.com server
generate_diff_with_vcs: run upload.py with --rev option to generate diffs against a specific branch or revision
guess_vcs_in_directory: run upload.py to auto-detect whether the current directory uses git svn or mercurial
encode_multipart_form_data: use EncodeMultipartFormData to encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data for HTTP upload
split_patch_by_file: use SplitPatch to split an svn diff output into separate patches for each file
